plans.name: Ultramodern Complete MV Delivery Waves (Wave 0–4)
plans.overview: Contract-first execution plan for turning main-ultramodern into a production-grade Micro-Verticals-first framework while preserving Modern.js capabilities, Zephyr compatibility, and compatibility lanes.

todos.content: Complete Wave 0 contract gates (must-pass) before implementation streams start.
Execute Wave 1 implementation streams in parallel (runtime parity, scaffolding, DS, Zephyr profile, ownership gates).
Complete Wave 2 integration pilot (reference superapp, extraction drill, chaos/failure drills).
Complete Wave 3 production rollout and certification.
Complete Wave 4 hardening, lane policy finalization, and compatibility-lane sunset decisions.
